tool_args.rationale: All five paid observations are positive and end by H=0.48, so none tests the proposed sign reversal. The slow-horizon probe measures near H=20, close to the H=21.7 target, where sustained positive gain and slow adaptation make different predictions.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows mostly constrain the net early gain, not the slow amplitude and time constant separately. A close pilot fit would not establish accuracy at H=21.7.
Finer sampling is less directly informative than measuring near the forecast horizon, where the candidate reversal should appear.
